last_scene.summary: Arlequino announced verbatim: 'Следующая посвящается самым великим воинам всех времен и рас! Называется "Сокрушитель великих"' and then performed the user-supplied lyrics with beastlike, demonic fury. Reactions were tied to exact moments. 'Ты жизнь отдал, Воин! / Но чудом спасён! / Ты доказал, что достоин!' pulled the loudest initial approval from fighters and veterans. The repeated command 'Будь со мной, Воин, будь со мной!' became easy for some younger listeners to answer or shout back. 'Грядёт последний бой! / Великий бой! / Твой главный бой! / Твой лучший бой!' drove a stronger martial roar and weapon-raising among part of the crowd. More mystical lines such as 'Вселенная кричит внутри тебя', 'тайны бытия', and 'Энергия течёт вокруг тебя' were not universally understood; some listened intensely while others cared mainly for the force of delivery. 'Меняй мир и будь моим Мечом!' produced cheers from some sword-users after their prior teasing. The later verse shifted the mood: 'Ничто не будет вечно под Луной', 'если силой долго держат власть — Тирану предрешено пасть!', and 'Всегда найдётся сила посильней' caused mixed reactions in Carrion's capital. Some took it as a general warrior truth about rulers and champions; one or two loyalist-minded listeners reacted defensively, stressing that Carrion was not named and should not be casually equated with a tyrant. No riot or official intervention occurred. 'А на того героя — свой герой! / Волна накроется волной!' resonated strongly with veterans and competitive fighters as a cycle of challengers replacing champions. The harsh climax 'Я жнец — кровавая косьба!' drew a roar from some younger fighters and grim silence from older listeners. The final contrast 'Вся эта мясорубка для людей / Зачем? / Ну такова жизнь.' ended without a unified cheer: some laughed darkly at the abrupt fatalism, others went quiet. The market continued around the performance and unrelated people kept working or leaving. Tips: 5s34c, expense 0, cash rises from 20g56s10c to 20g61s44c. Rena remains at the inn and has not witnessed this outing unless realistically informed.
